card.name: Partway through split-up words
card.fires_on: Pieces in the middle of a longer word that the text splits into parts, such as 'pec' in repec, 'pp' in floppiness, 'ROKE' in STROKE or 'cept' in susceptible. The words are varied, and the pole is only weakly active.

modes.label: Middle of ordinary words
modes.description: A middle piece of a common or less common word that is cut into several parts.
modes.example: flo<<pp>>iness rather than muscle twitching, soon

modes.label: Inside capitalised warning terms
modes.description: A piece in the middle of a medical term in an all-caps boxed warning heading.
modes.example: WARNING: AUTOIMMUNITY, INFUSION REACTIONS, ST<<ROKE>>, AND MALIGNANCIES LEM

card.plain: It fires weakly on the middle pieces of long or oddly split words, with no single topic.
